title: Moraine Lake, Lake Louise & Banff Tour from Calgary, Canmore
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the best of Banff National Park on a comfortable small-group tour from Calgary. Visit the iconic turquoise waters of Moraine Lake and Lake Louise, explore the charming town of Banff, enjoy scenic photo stops.

With a maximum of 14 guests, you'll enjoy a more personal experience, comfortable transportation, and a relaxed pace with no rushing between attractions. Take your time to enjoy the scenery, capture memorable photos, and experience the breathtaking beauty of the Canadian Rockies.
